apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: omos-tak-projector-script
  namespace: omos
data:
  projector.py: |
    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """
    omos-tak-projector — unified NATS → CoT → TAK bridge

    Subscribes to:
      1. ent.*.*.state   (core NATS — ORP fused entity states)
      2. intel.>         (JetStream durable consumer — intel events)

    Publishes CoT XML to tak.cot.inject which the NatsBridgePlugin fans
    out to all TAK clients (CloudTAK, iTAK, ATAK, WebTAK).

    Route (verified live):
      main NATS tak.cot.inject
        → tak-nats-leaf (bridges all subjects bidirectionally)
        → TAK internal NATS (takserver-nats)
        → PluginClusterMessenger → TAK messaging pod
        → CloudTAK / iTAK / ATAK / WebTAK / VRTAK (__ANON__ group)

    Control:
      cmd.projector.disable  → soft-pause all projection
      cmd.projector.enable   → resume
    """
    import asyncio, json, logging, os, ssl, sys, time, uuid
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

    import nats
    import nats.js.api

    LOG = logging.getLogger("omos-tak-projector")
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
        stream=sys.stdout,
    )

    NATS_URL      = os.getenv("NATS_URL",           "nats://nats.nats.svc.cluster.local:4222")
    NATS_USER     = os.getenv("NATS_USER",           "")
    NATS_PASSWORD = os.getenv("NATS_PASSWORD",       "")
    INJECT_SUBJ   = os.getenv("TAK_INJECT_SUBJECT",  "tak.cot.inject")
    TAK_GROUP     = os.getenv("TAK_GROUP",            "__ANON__")
    MIN_INTERVAL  = float(os.getenv("MIN_INTERVAL_SEC", "5"))

    XML_DECLARATION = b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes" ?>\n'
    W3C_DT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
    DEFAULT_COT_VAL = "9999999.0"

    _enabled = True

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # CoT type map (MIL-STD-2525C / TAK)
    # (cot_type, stale_seconds)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    COT_TYPE_MAP = {
        # Aircraft
        "aircraft":              ("a-f-A-M-F-Q", 60),
        "aircraft_multirotor":   ("a-f-A-M-F-Q", 60),
        "aircraft_fixed_wing":   ("a-f-A-M-F-F", 60),
        "uav":                   ("a-f-A-M-F-Q", 60),
        "drone":                 ("a-f-A-M-F-Q", 60),
        "helicopter":            ("a-f-A-M-F-H", 60),
        # Maritime
        "ship":                  ("a-f-S-X-W-U", 120),
        "vessel":                ("a-f-S-X-W-U", 120),
        "surface_vessel_usv":    ("a-f-S-X-W-U", 120),
        "maritime":              ("a-f-S-X-W-U", 120),
        # Ground
        "ground_vehicle":        ("a-f-G-U-C",   90),
        "ground_vehicle_wheeled":("a-f-G-U-C-V", 90),
        "vehicle":               ("a-f-G-U-C-V", 90),
        "robot":                 ("a-f-G-U-C-R", 90),
        # Human
        "human":                 ("a-f-G-U-C",   120),
        "operator":              ("a-f-G-U-C",   120),
        "operator_station":      ("a-f-G-E-V-C", 300),
        # Sensors
        "sensor":                ("a-f-G-I-S",   600),
        "sensor_platform":       ("a-f-G-I-S",   600),
        "camera":                ("a-f-G-I-S-C", 600),
        # Events / detections
        "fire":                  ("b-r-.-H-.",   3600),
        "wildfire":              ("b-r-.-H-.",   3600),
        "explosion":             ("b-r-.-H-.",   1800),
        "conflict":              ("b-r-.-C-.",   3600),
        "conflict_event":        ("a-h-G",       3600),
        "earthquake":            ("a-f-G-E-V-Q", 7200),
        "weather":               ("b-m-p",       1800),
        "weather_alert":         ("a-f-G-U-W",   1800),
        "hurricane":             ("b-m-p-H",     3600),
        "flood":                 ("b-r-.-F-.",   3600),
        # Intel / threats
        "threat":                ("a-h-G",        300),
        "hostile":               ("a-h-G",        300),
        "unknown_track":         ("a-u-A",        120),
        # Space
        "satellite":             ("a-f-A-C-F",   600),
        "space_object":          ("a-f-A-C",     600),
        "default":               ("a-f-G-U-C",   300),
    }

    # Weather alert → CoT type mapping (NOAA event names)
    WEATHER_COT_MAP = {
        "Tornado Warning":             "a-f-G-U-W-T",
        "Tornado Watch":               "a-f-G-U-W-T",
        "Severe Thunderstorm Warning": "a-f-G-U-W-S",
        "Severe Thunderstorm Watch":   "a-f-G-U-W-S",
        "Flash Flood Warning":         "a-f-G-U-W-F",
        "Flash Flood Watch":           "a-f-G-U-W-F",
        "Flood Warning":               "a-f-G-U-W-F",
        "Flood Watch":                 "a-f-G-U-W-F",
        "Hurricane Warning":           "a-f-G-U-W-H",
        "Hurricane Watch":             "a-f-G-U-W-H",
        "Tropical Storm Warning":      "a-f-G-U-W-H",
        "Tropical Storm Watch":        "a-f-G-U-W-H",
        "Winter Storm Warning":        "a-f-G-U-W-W",
        "Blizzard Warning":            "a-f-G-U-W-W",
        "Ice Storm Warning":           "a-f-G-U-W-W",
        "Winter Weather Advisory":     "a-f-G-U-W-W",
        "Excessive Heat Warning":      "a-f-G-U-W-E",
        "Heat Advisory":               "a-f-G-U-W-E",
        "Extreme Cold Warning":        "a-f-G-U-W-W",
        "Wind Advisory":               "a-f-G-U-W",
        "High Wind Warning":           "a-f-G-U-W",
        "Red Flag Warning":            "a-f-G-U-F-F",
        "Wildfire Warning":            "a-f-G-U-F-F",
        "Dust Storm Warning":          "a-f-G-U-W",
        "Tsunami Warning":             "a-f-G-U-W-T",
        "Tsunami Watch":               "a-f-G-U-W-T",
        "Special Weather Statement":   "a-f-G-U-W",
    }

    def cot_meta(entity_type: str):
        t = (entity_type or "").lower().replace("-", "_")
        return COT_TYPE_MAP.get(t, COT_TYPE_MAP["default"])

    def cot_time(stale_secs: int = 0) -> str:
        t = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=stale_secs)
        return t.strftime(W3C_DT)

    def safe_float(val, default=None):
        try:
            return float(val) if val is not None else default
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return default

    def parse_iso(s: str) -> datetime:
        s = s.rstrip("Z")
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(s, fmt).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            except ValueError:
                continue
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Entity state → CoT (ent.*.*.state — ORP fused entities)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def entity_to_cot(entity: dict) -> tuple:
        lat = safe_float(entity.get("lat") or entity.get("latitude"))
        lon = safe_float(entity.get("lon") or entity.get("longitude"))
        if lat is None or lon is None:
            return None, None
        if not (-90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lon <= 180):
            return None, None

        entity_id   = entity.get("entity_id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
        entity_type = entity.get("entity_type", "default")
        props       = entity.get("properties") or {}
        ctype, stale_secs = cot_meta(entity_type)

        callsign = str(
            props.get("name") or props.get("callsign") or props.get("flight") or
            props.get("mmsi") or props.get("icao_hex") or props.get("tail") or
            entity_id
        )[:64]

        hae    = safe_float(props.get("altitude") or props.get("hae") or props.get("alt"))
        speed  = safe_float(props.get("speed") or props.get("sog") or props.get("velocity"), 0.0)
        course = safe_float(props.get("course") or props.get("heading") or props.get("cog") or props.get("track"), 0.0)
        ce     = safe_float(props.get("ce"))
        le_val = safe_float(props.get("le"))
        conf   = safe_float(entity.get("confidence"), 1.0)

        uid = f"OM.{entity_type}.{entity_id}"
        now = cot_time()

        event = ET.Element("event")
        event.set("version", "2.0")
        event.set("type",    ctype)
        event.set("uid",     uid)
        event.set("how",     "m-g")
        event.set("time",    now)
        event.set("start",   now)
        event.set("stale",   cot_time(stale_secs))
        event.set("access",  "Unclassified")

        point = ET.SubElement(event, "point")
        point.set("lat", f"{lat:.6f}")
        point.set("lon", f"{lon:.6f}")
        point.set("hae",  str(hae) if hae is not None else DEFAULT_COT_VAL)
        point.set("ce",   str(ce)  if ce  is not None else DEFAULT_COT_VAL)
        point.set("le",   str(le_val) if le_val is not None else DEFAULT_COT_VAL)

        detail = ET.SubElement(event, "detail")
        flow = ET.SubElement(detail, "_flow-tags_")
        flow.set("omos-tak-projector", now)
        contact = ET.SubElement(detail, "contact")
        contact.set("callsign", callsign)
        track_el = ET.SubElement(detail, "track")
        track_el.set("speed",  f"{speed:.2f}")
        track_el.set("course", f"{course:.1f}")
        remarks = ET.SubElement(detail, "remarks")
        remarks.text = f"src=orp t={entity_type} conf={conf:.2f}"
        group = ET.SubElement(detail, "__group")
        group.set("name", TAK_GROUP)
        group.set("role", "Team Member")

        cot_bytes = XML_DECLARATION + ET.tostring(event, encoding="unicode").encode()
        return uid, cot_bytes

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Intel event → CoT (intel.> — JetStream durable)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def intel_event_type_to_cot(entity_type: str, properties: dict) -> str:
        if entity_type == "earthquake":
            return "a-f-G-E-V-Q"
        if entity_type == "wildfire":
            return "a-f-G-U-F-F"
        if entity_type == "conflict_event":
            return "a-h-G"
        if entity_type == "weather_alert":
            event_name = properties.get("event", "")
            return WEATHER_COT_MAP.get(event_name, "a-f-G-U-W")
        return "a-f-G-U-O"

    def intel_to_cot(envelope: dict) -> tuple:
        uid         = envelope.get("id", "unknown")
        entity_type = envelope.get("type", "")
        source      = envelope.get("source", "")
        lat         = safe_float(envelope.get("lat"))
        lon         = safe_float(envelope.get("lon"))
        timestamp   = envelope.get("timestamp", "")
        expires     = envelope.get("expires", "")
        properties  = envelope.get("properties", {})

        if lat is None or lon is None:
            return None, None
        if not (-90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lon <= 180):
            return None, None

        cot_type = intel_event_type_to_cot(entity_type, properties)

        ts_dt = parse_iso(timestamp) if timestamp else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        ex_dt = parse_iso(expires) if expires else ts_dt + timedelta(minutes=30)
        now = cot_time()

        headline = properties.get("headline", properties.get("event", entity_type))
        remarks_text = f"{headline}\nSource: {source}\nID: {uid}"

        event = ET.Element("event")
        event.set("version", "2.0")
        event.set("type",    cot_type)
        event.set("uid",     f"INTEL.{uid}")
        event.set("how",     "m-g")
        event.set("time",    now)
        event.set("start",   ts_dt.strftime(W3C_DT))
        event.set("stale",   ex_dt.strftime(W3C_DT))

        point = ET.SubElement(event, "point")
        point.set("lat", f"{lat:.6f}")
        point.set("lon", f"{lon:.6f}")
        point.set("hae", "0")
        point.set("ce",  DEFAULT_COT_VAL)
        point.set("le",  DEFAULT_COT_VAL)

        detail = ET.SubElement(event, "detail")
        flow = ET.SubElement(detail, "_flow-tags_")
        flow.set("omos-tak-projector", now)
        contact = ET.SubElement(detail, "contact")
        contact.set("callsign", str(headline)[:64])
        remarks = ET.SubElement(detail, "remarks")
        remarks.text = remarks_text
        color = ET.SubElement(detail, "color")
        color.set("argb", "-65536")
        group = ET.SubElement(detail, "__group")
        group.set("name", TAK_GROUP)
        group.set("role", "Team Member")

        cot_bytes = XML_DECLARATION + ET.tostring(event, encoding="unicode").encode()
        return f"INTEL.{uid}", cot_bytes

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Main
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async def main():
        global _enabled

        LOG.info("omos-tak-projector (unified) → %s [group=%s]", INJECT_SUBJ, TAK_GROUP)
        LOG.info("  subscriptions: ent.*.*.state (core) + intel.> (JetStream durable)")

        tls_ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
        tls_ctx.check_hostname = False
        tls_ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE

        opts = {
            "servers":                NATS_URL,
            "name":                   "omos-tak-projector",
            "max_reconnect_attempts": -1,
            "reconnect_time_wait":    2,
            "tls":                    tls_ctx,
        }
        if NATS_USER:
            opts["user"]     = NATS_USER
            opts["password"] = NATS_PASSWORD

        async def _error_cb(e):
            LOG.error(f"NATS error: {e}")
        async def _reconnected_cb():
            LOG.info("NATS reconnected")
        async def _disconnected_cb():
            LOG.warning("NATS disconnected")

        opts["error_cb"] = _error_cb
        opts["reconnected_cb"] = _reconnected_cb
        opts["disconnected_cb"] = _disconnected_cb

        nc = await nats.connect(**opts)
        LOG.info("NATS connected")

        ent_published = 0
        intel_published = 0
        skipped = 0
        last_pub: dict = {}

        # --- Entity state handler (core NATS subscription) ---
        async def entity_handler(msg):
            nonlocal ent_published, skipped
            if not _enabled:
                return
            try:
                entity = json.loads(msg.data.decode())
            except Exception:
                skipped += 1
                return

            uid, cot_bytes = entity_to_cot(entity)
            if cot_bytes is None:
                skipped += 1
                return

            now_ts = time.monotonic()
            if now_ts - last_pub.get(uid, 0) < MIN_INTERVAL:
                return
            last_pub[uid] = now_ts

            if ent_published % 10000 == 0 and ent_published > 0:
                cutoff = now_ts - MIN_INTERVAL * 10
                for k in [k for k, v in last_pub.items() if v < cutoff]:
                    del last_pub[k]

            await nc.publish(INJECT_SUBJ, cot_bytes)
            ent_published += 1
            if ent_published <= 5 or ent_published % 500 == 0:
                LOG.info("ENT CoT #%d %s/%s → %s",
                         ent_published, entity.get("entity_type", "?"),
                         entity.get("entity_id", "?"), INJECT_SUBJ)

        # --- Intel event handler (JetStream durable consumer) ---
        async def intel_handler(msg):
            nonlocal intel_published, skipped
            if not _enabled:
                await msg.ack()
                return
            try:
                envelope = json.loads(msg.data.decode())
            except Exception:
                skipped += 1
                await msg.ack()
                return

            uid, cot_bytes = intel_to_cot(envelope)
            if cot_bytes is None:
                skipped += 1
                await msg.ack()
                return

            await nc.publish(INJECT_SUBJ, cot_bytes)
            intel_published += 1
            if intel_published <= 5 or intel_published % 100 == 0:
                LOG.info("INTEL CoT #%d %s → %s",
                         intel_published, envelope.get("type", "?"), INJECT_SUBJ)
            await msg.ack()

        # --- Control handlers ---
        async def handle_disable(msg):
            global _enabled
            _enabled = False
            LOG.info("projector DISABLED via cmd.projector.disable")

        async def handle_enable(msg):
            global _enabled
            _enabled = True
            LOG.info("projector ENABLED via cmd.projector.enable")

        await nc.subscribe("cmd.projector.disable", cb=handle_disable)
        await nc.subscribe("cmd.projector.enable",  cb=handle_enable)

        # Subscribe: entity states (core NATS — no JetStream)
        await nc.subscribe("ent.*.*.state", cb=entity_handler)
        LOG.info("subscribed: ent.*.*.state (core NATS)")

        # Subscribe: intel events (JetStream durable consumer)
        js = nc.jetstream()
        await js.subscribe(
            "intel.>",
            durable="sink-tak",
            cb=intel_handler,
            deliver_policy=nats.js.api.DeliverPolicy.NEW,
        )
        LOG.info("subscribed: intel.> (JetStream durable=sink-tak)")

        try:
            while True:
                await asyncio.sleep(60)
                LOG.info("heartbeat ent=%d intel=%d skipped=%d uids=%d enabled=%s",
                         ent_published, intel_published, skipped, len(last_pub), _enabled)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        finally:
            await nc.drain()

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        try:
            asyncio.run(main())
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: omos-intel-scripts
  namespace: omos
data:
  sink_clickhouse.py: |
    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """
    sink_clickhouse.py — NATS intel sink → ClickHouse onemind.events

    Subscribes to:
      - intel.>  (JetStream push consumer, durable: sink-clickhouse)
      - ent.*.*.state  (core NATS — KV mirrors)

    Batches up to 100 rows or 5 seconds, then HTTP-POSTs to ClickHouse
    as newline-delimited JSONEachRow.  Survives ClickHouse downtime by
    logging the error, discarding the batch, and continuing.
    """
    import asyncio
    import json
    import logging
    import os
    import ssl
    import sys
    import time
    import urllib.request
    import urllib.error
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    import nats
    from nats.js.api import ConsumerConfig, DeliverPolicy

    LOG = logging.getLogger("sink-clickhouse")
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
        stream=sys.stdout,
    )

    NATS_URL      = os.getenv("NATS_URL",      "nats://nats.nats.svc.cluster.local:4222")
    NATS_USER     = os.getenv("NATS_USER",     "")
    NATS_PASSWORD = os.getenv("NATS_PASSWORD", "")
    CH_HOST       = os.getenv("CH_HOST",       "clickhouse-onemind.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local")
    CH_PORT       = os.getenv("CH_PORT",       "8123")
    CH_USER       = os.getenv("CH_USER",       "onemind")
    CH_PASSWORD   = os.getenv("CH_PASSWORD",   "")

    BATCH_MAX  = 100
    BATCH_SECS = 5.0

    CH_URL = (
        f"http://{CH_HOST}:{CH_PORT}/"
        "?query=INSERT+INTO+onemind.events+FORMAT+JSONEachRow"
    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Field extraction helpers
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _safe_float(val) -> float | None:
        try:
            return float(val) if val is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None


    def extract_fields(subject: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
        tokens = subject.split(".")

        # entity_id
        entity_id = (
            payload.get("id")
            or payload.get("entity_id")
            or (tokens[-1] if tokens else "unknown")
        )

        # entity_type — subject token index 2 (e.g. intel.{domain}.{source}.{type} → tokens[3])
        # For ent.{entity_type}.{entity_id}.state → tokens[1]
        if tokens and tokens[0] == "ent" and len(tokens) >= 2:
            entity_type = payload.get("type") or payload.get("entity_type") or tokens[1]
        else:
            entity_type = (
                payload.get("type")
                or payload.get("entity_type")
                or (tokens[2] if len(tokens) > 2 else "unknown")
            )

        # source — payload.source or subject token 1
        source = payload.get("source") or (tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else "unknown")

        # lat/lon — direct fields or GeoJSON geometry
        lat = _safe_float(payload.get("lat"))
        lon = _safe_float(payload.get("lon"))
        if lat is None or lon is None:
            geom = payload.get("geometry") or {}
            coords = geom.get("coordinates")
            if isinstance(coords, (list, tuple)) and len(coords) >= 2:
                lon = _safe_float(coords[0])
                lat = _safe_float(coords[1])

        return {
            "entity_id":   str(entity_id),
            "entity_type": str(entity_type),
            "source":      str(source),
            "lat":         lat,
            "lon":         lon,
        }


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ClickHouse flush
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def flush_to_clickhouse(batch: list[dict]) -> None:
        body = "\n".join(json.dumps(row) for row in batch).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            CH_URL,
            data=body,
            method="POST",
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/x-ndjson",
                "X-ClickHouse-User": CH_USER,
                "X-ClickHouse-Key":  CH_PASSWORD,
            },
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                status = resp.status
            LOG.info("flushed batch=%d status=%d", len(batch), status)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            body_text = exc.read(512).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            LOG.error("ClickHouse HTTP %d — batch discarded: %s", exc.code, body_text)
        except Exception as exc:
            LOG.error("ClickHouse unavailable — batch discarded: %s", exc)


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Batch accumulator
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    class Batcher:
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self._rows: list[dict] = []
            self._deadline: float = time.monotonic() + BATCH_SECS
            self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

        async def add(self, row: dict) -> None:
            async with self._lock:
                self._rows.append(row)
                should_flush = (
                    len(self._rows) >= BATCH_MAX
                    or time.monotonic() >= self._deadline
                )
                if should_flush:
                    await self._flush_locked()

        async def _flush_locked(self) -> None:
            if not self._rows:
                self._deadline = time.monotonic() + BATCH_SECS
                return
            batch, self._rows = self._rows, []
            self._deadline = time.monotonic() + BATCH_SECS
            # Run blocking HTTP call in a thread so we don't block the event loop
            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
            await loop.run_in_executor(None, flush_to_clickhouse, batch)

        async def flush_if_due(self) -> None:
            async with self._lock:
                if self._rows and time.monotonic() >= self._deadline:
                    await self._flush_locked()

        async def flush_all(self) -> None:
            async with self._lock:
                await self._flush_locked()

    # Message handler
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def make_handler(batcher: Batcher):
        async def handler(msg) -> None:
            subject = msg.subject
            try:
                payload = json.loads(msg.data.decode("utf-8"))
            except Exception as exc:
                LOG.warning("JSON parse error on %s — skipping: %s", subject, exc)
                return

            fields = extract_fields(subject, payload)
            now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]

            row: dict = {
                "timestamp":   now_iso,
                "subject":     subject,
                "entity_id":   fields["entity_id"],
                "entity_type": fields["entity_type"],
                "source":      fields["source"],
                "payload":     msg.data.decode("utf-8"),
            }
            if fields["lat"] is not None:
                row["lat"] = fields["lat"]
            if fields["lon"] is not None:
                row["lon"] = fields["lon"]

            await batcher.add(row)

        return handler

    # Main
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def main() -> None:
        LOG.info(
            "sink-clickhouse starting — NATS=%s CH=%s:%s",
            NATS_URL, CH_HOST, CH_PORT,
        )

        opts = {
            "servers":                NATS_URL,
            "name":                   "sink-clickhouse",
            "max_reconnect_attempts": -1,
            "reconnect_time_wait":    2,

        tls_ctx.check_hostname = False
        tls_ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
        opts["tls"] = tls_ctx
        nc = await nats.connect(**opts)
        LOG.info("NATS connected")

        js = nc.jetstream()
        batcher = Batcher()
        handler = make_handler(batcher)

        # JetStream push consumer — durable, deliver to _INBOX.sink-ch
        consumer_cfg = ConsumerConfig(
            durable_name="sink-clickhouse",
            deliver_subject="_INBOX.sink-ch",
            deliver_policy=DeliverPolicy.LAST_PER_SUBJECT,
            filter_subject="intel.>",
            ack_policy="none",
        )
        js_sub = await js.subscribe(
            "intel.>",
            config=consumer_cfg,
            cb=handler,
            manual_ack=True,
        )
        LOG.info("JetStream push consumer subscribed to intel.>  (durable=sink-clickhouse)")

        # Core NATS subscription — ent.*.*.state (KV mirrors)
        core_sub = await nc.subscribe("ent.*.*.state", cb=handler)
        LOG.info("core NATS subscribed to ent.*.*.state")

        # Timer loop: flush partial batches on the 5-second deadline
        try:
            while True:
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                await batcher.flush_if_due()
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        finally:
            await batcher.flush_all()
            await js_sub.unsubscribe()
            await core_sub.unsubscribe()
            await nc.drain()

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        try:
            asyncio.run(main())
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass

    def slugify(text: str) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")

    def extract_state_from_zones(zones: list[str]) -> str:
        for z in zones:
            m = re.match(r"^([A-Z]{2})[CZ]\d", z)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        return "XX"

    def poly_centroid(coordinates) -> tuple[float, float]:
        ring = coordinates[0]
        lon = sum(p[0] for p in ring) / len(ring)
        lat = sum(p[1] for p in ring) / len(ring)
        return lat, lon

    def multipolygon_centroid(coordinates) -> tuple[float, float]:
        all_pts = [p for poly in coordinates for p in poly[0]]
        lon = sum(p[0] for p in all_pts) / len(all_pts)
        lat = sum(p[1] for p in all_pts) / len(all_pts)
        return lat, lon

    async def zone_centroid(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, zone_url: str):
        try:
            async with session.get(zone_url, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10)) as r:
                if r.status != 200:
                    return None
                data = await r.json(content_type=None)
            geom = data.get("geometry") or {}
            gtype = geom.get("type", "")
            coords = geom.get("coordinates")
            if not coords:
                return None
            if gtype == "Polygon":
                return poly_centroid(coords)
            if gtype == "MultiPolygon":
                return multipolygon_centroid(coords)
            if gtype == "Point":
                return coords[1], coords[0]
        except Exception as e:
            LOG.debug(f"zone centroid fetch failed {zone_url}: {e}")
        return None

    def now_iso() -> str:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    async def resolve_geometry(session, feat: dict, state: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
        geom   = feat.get("geometry") or {}
        gtype  = geom.get("type", "")
        coords = geom.get("coordinates")
        if coords:
            if gtype == "Point":
                return coords[1], coords[0]
            if gtype == "Polygon":
                return poly_centroid(coords)
            if gtype == "MultiPolygon":
                return multipolygon_centroid(coords)
        props    = feat.get("properties", {})
        affected = props.get("affectedZones") or []
        if affected:
            pt = await zone_centroid(session, affected[0])
            if pt:
                return pt
        fallback = STATE_CENTROIDS.get(state.upper())
        if fallback:
            return fallback
        LOG.warning(f"No geometry resolved for state={state} alert id={feat.get('id')}")
        return 0.0, 0.0

    def build_subject(state: str, event_type: str) -> str:
        return f"intel.weather.noaa.alert.{state.lower()}.{slugify(event_type)}"

            "type":       "weather_alert",
            "source":     "noaa",

            "lon":        round(lon, 6),
            "timestamp":  props.get("sent") or now_iso(),

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Poll
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def poll(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, js, seen: set, areas: list[str]) -> int:

        if areas and areas != ["US"]:
            params["area"] = ",".join(areas)
        url = f"{NOAA_BASE}/alerts/active"
        try:
            async with session.get(
                url,
                params=params,
                headers={"Accept": "application/geo+json", "User-Agent": "omos-feed-intel-noaa/1.0"},

                data = await r.json(content_type=None)
        except Exception as e:

            return 0

        published = 0
        for feat in features:
            alert_id = feat.get("id", "")
            if not alert_id or alert_id in seen:
                continue
            props      = feat.get("properties", {})
            event_type = props.get("event", "alert")
            affected   = props.get("affectedZones") or []
            state = extract_state_from_zones([z.split("/")[-1] for z in affected]) if affected else "XX"

                LOG.error(f"NATS publish error {subject}: {e}")

            LOG.info(f"NOAA: published {published} new alerts (total seen={len(seen)})")
        return published

        tls_ctx.check_hostname = False
        tls_ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
        nc = await nats.connect(

    def magnitude_bucket(mag: float) -> str:

        if mag >= 4.0: return "m4plus"
        if mag >= 3.0: return "m3plus"
        return "m2plus"

    def now_iso() -> str:

            "type":      "earthquake",
            "source":    "usgs",
            "lat":       round(lat, 6),
            "lon":       round(lon, 6),
            "timestamp": ms_to_iso(props.get("time")),

            async with session.get(
                USGS_URL,
                headers={"User-Agent": "omos-feed-intel-usgs/1.0"},
                timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=20),
            ) as r:

                    LOG.warning(f"USGS HTTP {r.status}")

            bucket  = magnitude_bucket(mag)
            cid     = clean_id(fid)
            subject = f"intel.seismic.usgs.{bucket}.{cid}"

    """
    feed_intel_runner — runs all intel feed coroutines in a single process.

    Each feed runs as an independent asyncio task with a supervised restart
    loop. One feed crashing does not affect the others.
    """
    import asyncio
    import importlib.util
    import logging
    import sys
    import os

    LOG = logging.getLogger("feed-intel-runner")
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s",
        stream=sys.stdout,
    )

    FEEDS = [
        "feed_intel_noaa",
        "feed_intel_usgs",
        "feed_intel_acled",
        "feed_intel_firms",
        "feed_intel_gdacs",
        "feed_intel_emsc",
        "feed_intel_eonet",
    ]

    RESTART_DELAY = 15  # seconds between crash restarts

    def load_module(name):
        path = f"/scripts/{name}.py"
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
        mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[name] = mod
        spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
        return mod

    async def supervised(name, mod):
        while True:
            try:
                LOG.info("[%s] starting", name)
                await mod.main()
                LOG.warning("[%s] main() returned unexpectedly, restarting in %ds",
                            name, RESTART_DELAY)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                LOG.info("[%s] cancelled", name)
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                LOG.error("[%s] crashed: %s — restarting in %ds",
                          name, exc, RESTART_DELAY)
            await asyncio.sleep(RESTART_DELAY)

    async def main():
        LOG.info("feed-intel-runner starting %d feeds", len(FEEDS))
        modules = {}
        for name in FEEDS:
            try:
                modules[name] = load_module(name)
                LOG.info("  loaded %s", name)
            except Exception as exc:
                LOG.error("  failed to load %s: %s — skipping", name, exc)

        tasks = [
            asyncio.create_task(supervised(name, mod), name=name)
            for name, mod in modules.items()
        ]

        try:
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            for t in tasks:
                t.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        asyncio.run(main())

    from sgp4.api import Satrec, jday

    LOG = logging.getLogger("feed-satellites")
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")

    NATS_URL  = os.getenv("NATS_URL", "nats://localhost:4222")
    NATS_USER = os.getenv("NATS_USER", "")
    NATS_PASS = os.getenv("NATS_PASSWORD", "")
    GROUP     = os.getenv("CELESTRAK_GROUP", "stations")
    INTERVAL  = int(os.getenv("PROPAGATE_INTERVAL", "30"))
    INJECT    = "tak.cot.inject"
    XML_DECL  = b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes" ?>\n'

    # Use TLE text format — each entry is 3 lines: name, TLE line 1, TLE line 2
    CELESTRAK_URL = f"https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?GROUP={GROUP}&FORMAT=tle"

    sats = []      # list of Satrec objects
    sat_names = {} # satnum → name string (Satrec is a C extension, can't set attrs)

    def now_str(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
    def stale_str(s=120): return (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=s)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")

    def eci_to_geodetic(r, gmst):
        x, y, z = r
        lon = math.degrees(math.atan2(y, x) - gmst)
        lon = ((lon + 180) % 360) - 180
        lat = math.degrees(math.atan2(z, math.sqrt(x**2 + y**2)))
        alt = math.sqrt(x**2 + y**2 + z**2) - 6371.0
        return lat, lon, alt

    def sat_to_cot(sat, now):
        jd, fr = jday(now.year, now.month, now.day,
                       now.hour, now.minute,
                       now.second + now.microsecond / 1e6)
        e, r, _ = sat.sgp4(jd, fr)
        if e != 0 or r is None: return None
        # GMST (simplified)
        d = (jd - 2451545.0) + fr
        gmst = math.radians((280.46061837 + 360.98564736629 * d) % 360)
        lat, lon, alt_km = eci_to_geodetic(r, gmst)
        uid = f"SAT-{sat.satnum}"
        name = sat_names.get(sat.satnum, str(sat.satnum))
        ts, st = now_str(), stale_str(INTERVAL * 3)
        MARTI_BROADCAST = '<marti><dest mission="Air"/></marti>'
        xml = (
            f'<event version="2.0" type="a-f-A-M-F-Q" uid="{uid}" '
            f'how="m-g" time="{ts}" start="{ts}" stale="{st}">'
            f'<point lat="{lat:.4f}" lon="{lon:.4f}" hae="{alt_km*1000:.0f}" ce="9999999.0" le="9999999.0"/>'
            f'<detail>'
            f'<contact callsign="{name}"/>'
            f'<status readiness="false"/>'
            f'<remarks>NORAD:{sat.satnum} group:{GROUP}</remarks>'
            f'{MARTI_BROADCAST}'
            f'<_flow-tags_ TAK-Server="SAT-Feed" time="{ts}"/>'
            f'</detail></event>'
        )
        return XML_DECL + xml.encode()

    async def load_tles(session):
        global sats
        try:
            async with session.get(CELESTRAK_URL, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30)) as r:
                text = await r.text()
            lines = [l.strip() for l in text.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
            new = []
            # TLE format: groups of 3 lines — name, line1, line2
            i = 0
            while i + 2 < len(lines):
                name = lines[i]
                l1   = lines[i+1]
                l2   = lines[i+2]
                if l1.startswith('1 ') and l2.startswith('2 '):
                    try:
                        s = Satrec.twoline2rv(l1, l2)
                        sat_names[s.satnum] = name
                        new.append(s)
                        i += 3
                    except Exception:
                        i += 1
                else:
                    i += 1
            sats = new
            LOG.info(f"Loaded {len(sats)} TLEs for group={GROUP}")
        except Exception as e:
            LOG.error(f"TLE refresh error: {e}")

    async def main():
        tls = ssl.create_default_context(); tls.check_hostname = False; tls.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
        nc = await nats.connect(servers=NATS_URL, user=NATS_USER, password=NATS_PASS, tls=tls)
        LOG.info("NATS connected")
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers={"User-Agent": "omos-feed-sats/1.0"}) as ses:
            await load_tles(ses)
            tle_t = 0
            while True:
                import time
                if time.time() - tle_t > 3600 * 4:
                    await load_tles(ses)
                    tle_t = time.time()
                now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                published = 0
                for sat in sats:
                    cot = sat_to_cot(sat, now)
                    if cot:
                        await nc.publish(INJECT, cot)
                        published += 1
                LOG.info(f"Satellites: published {published}/{len(sats)} positions")
                await asyncio.sleep(INTERVAL)

    asyncio.run(main())

# KEDA ScaledObject for sink-clickhouse, driven by the INTEL/sink-clickhouse JetStream consumer lag.
#
# OBSERVE-ONLY on purpose: min 1 / max 1 keeps the Deployment at exactly one replica, same as
# the Deployment's own `replicas: 1`, so Argo CD and KEDA do not fight. What this buys today is
# proof that KEDA can read the NATS monitoring endpoint and see the consumer lag (check
# `kubectl -n omos get scaledobject,hpa`). See docs/operations/keda-scalers.md before changing it.
#
# Why not scale to zero:
#   * sink-clickhouse also holds a core-NATS subscription (ent.*.*.state). Core NATS is not
#     durable, so every message published while the pod is at 0 is lost.
#   * It is a push consumer with no deliver group; a second replica cannot bind, so max is 1.
#   * INTEL carries constant traffic (consumer last_active within seconds), so there is no idle
#     window to save, and the sink writes to onemind.events ("NEVER DROP").
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: sink-clickhouse
  namespace: omos
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: sink-clickhouse
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: omos-platform
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: sink-clickhouse
  minReplicaCount: 1
  maxReplicaCount: 1
  pollingInterval: 30
  triggers:
    - type: nats-jetstream
      metadata:
        # Headless service so KEDA can reach each server (nats-0/1/2.nats-headless) and find
        # the consumer leader; /jsz on a follower does not report authoritative lag.
        natsServerMonitoringEndpoint: nats-headless.nats.svc.cluster.local:8222
        account: ONEMIND
        stream: INTEL
        consumer: sink-clickhouse
        # lag = num_pending + num_ack_pending
        lagThreshold: "100"
        activationLagThreshold: "1"
        useHttps: "false"

# platform-omos: tak-projector + live world feeds + omos-mission-engine
#
# Covers:
#   platform/omos/              — tak-projector, AIS/ADS-B/APRS/hazard feeds, sinks
#   platform/omos/mission-engine-*.yaml — mission orchestration (merged)
#
# tak-projector is the NATS→CoT→CloudTAK bridge:
#   Subscribes: ent.*.state, tel.*.position, det.*, intel.*
#   Publishes:  tak.cot.inject  → CloudTAK map entities + tracks
#
# Live world feeds publish to NATS subjects that tak-projector picks up:
#   feed-ships      → tel.ship.*.position    (AIS via aisstream.io)
#   feed-aircraft   → tel.aircraft.*.position (ADS-B via OpenSky)
#   feed-aprs       → tel.aprs.*.position    (APRS trackers)
#   feed-satellites → tel.sat.*.position     (TLE orbital positions)
#   feed-hazards    → det.hazard.*.alert     (NOAA hazard warnings)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: platform-omos
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "3"
  finalizers:
    - resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/onemindos/omos.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: platform/omos
    directory:
      recurse: false
      exclude: "*.secret*,*.env"
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: omos
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
      - CreateNamespace=true
  ignoreDifferences:
    - group: apps
      kind: Deployment
      jsonPointers:
        - /spec/template/metadata/annotations
        - /spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources
